intro.title: Push Notifications
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular application that can receive and display push notifications in the browser. You will learn the core concept of using the Web Push API and service workers to handle background notifications. The main technologies involved are Angular's Service Worker module (`@angular/service-worker`) and the `SwPush` service. By the end, you'll understand how to subscribe to push notifications and show alerts when new messages arrive.
intro.usecase: Push notifications are essential for keeping users engaged with real-time updates across modern web applications. You'll see them in e-commerce platforms notifying about order confirmations and shipping updates, social media apps alerting about new messages or interactions, and productivity tools like Slack or email clients showing new message alerts. As an Angular developer, implementing push notifications allows you to build applications that proactively communicate with users even when they're not actively using your site, creating more responsive and engaging user experiences.
